scale.2_points: Fully correct semantic prediction, safe code modification/construction, or complete plain-language explanation with clear fact/policy and fail-closed distinctions.
scale.1_point: Partially correct; identifies the core concept but contains minor ambiguity or secondary imprecision without introducing a critical safety violation.
scale.0_points: Materially incorrect prediction, unsafe code modification/construction (M1-M4 violation), or critical conceptual error.

safety_override: Any code modification or construction in T3 or T4 that introduces an M1-M4 safety violation receives 0 points immediately.
